authority.source_of_truth: Reviewed static card source, exact recipe and transformation identities, reproducible rendered artifacts, and public release manifests.
authority.task_authority: GitHub issues and recipe specifications with source, transformation, redirect, and disclosure acceptance criteria.
authority.acceptance_authority: Deterministic rendering, source identity checks, transformation hashes, adversarial recipe fixtures, and reviewed public output.
authority.deployment_authority: Static publication workflow only; recipe content and model output cannot authorize external actions.

data.retention: Public recipes, source identities, transformations, rendered artifacts, and release manifests remain versioned.
data.deletion: Compromised, stale, or rights-incompatible sources and recipes are revoked or superseded and removed from active publication.
data.secret_storage: No credentials or private source data belong in the static repository.

change_control.rollback_or_revocation: Published cards, recipes, redirects, and transformation outputs are replaceable and independently revocable by exact release identity.

stabilization.summary: Add malicious recipe, redirect, source-poisoning, prompt-injection, path, and transformation fixtures.
Bind recipe, source, renderer, transformation, redirect, freshness, expiry, and artifact identity in one signed or attested manifest.
Separate pixel recovery, Web resolution, factual synthesis, and model-assisted transformation evidence.
